description.narrative: The overall Objective and desired Outcome of the Inception Phase is that the Albanian Government has re-calibrated its approach to the Property Tax Reform and developed a realistic roadmap for its implementation, well-anchored among its main stakeholders. This roadmap constitutes a clear and predictable basis for continued development of institutional capacity supported by Sweden.

Bidraget syftar till att stödja den albanska regeringen i förberedelserna för genomförandet av fastighetsskattereformen. Syftet med Fastighetsskattereformen är att etablera samförvaltning mellan kommuner och det centraliserade generaldirektoratet för fastighetsskatt. Detta kommer att förbättra den övergripande effektiviteten genom att utnyttja stordriftsfördelar samt automatisering genom teknik.

The contribution aims to support the Albanian Government in the preparation for the implementation of the Property Tax Reform. The aim of Property Tax Reform is to establish co-administration between municipalities and the centralized General Directorate of Property Tax. This will improve the overall efficiency by exploiting economies of scale as well as automation by technology.

During 2024, project activities focused on institutional collaboration, legal drafting, IT system refinement, and planning processes. Activities were implemented by a mix of resident expertise (STA Resident Advisor, locally contracted legal and IT experts), short-term missions from Sweden, and General Directorate of Property Tax (GDPT)s internal contributions.
The following immediate results were achieved: - Draft legislation refined and transitional regulatory approach outlined. - Ongoing maintenance and iterative refinement of the Fiscal Cadaster Information System (FCIS) platform. - Joint draft of a project proposal for subsequent phases (not adopted, but instructional). - GDPT managers and legal staff strengthened their understanding of the legal reform framework. - GDPT staff enhanced their familiarity with the FCIS modules. - GDPT staff enhanced their knowledge in property appraisal, regarding residential apartments. - GDPT staff gained enhanced knowledge in service provision (focused on support to Local Government Units - LGUs).
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
